items.briefing:
Ransomware attacks are becoming faster and harder to defend against, with cybercriminals now using AI tools to speed up their attacks on organisations. This means there is less time between a network being compromised and data being stolen or encrypted, making early detection more critical than ever for Australian organisations like ours.

**Practical tip:** Make sure your important files are regularly backed up and stored separately from your main network — if ransomware strikes, a clean backup could be the difference between a quick recovery and a costly shutdown.

featured.title: Ransomware attacks speed up as hackers use AI tools
featured.quote: AI-powered ransomware attacks accelerating against Australian manufacturers poses critical infrastructure risk.
